# netbox_manufacturers (Data Source)

Fetches the list of manufacturers from netbox. Can optionally be filtered by name, slug or tag.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/manufacturer/):

> A manufacturer represents the "make" of a device; e.g. Cisco or Dell. Each device type must be assigned to a manufacturer. (Inventory items and platforms may also be associated with manufacturers.)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_manufacturers" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "Juniper"
  }
}

output "manufacturers" {
  value = data.netbox_manufacturers.example.manufacturers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `manufacturers` (Attributes List) The manufacturers found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manufacturers))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--manufacturers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `manufacturers`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the manufacturers.
- `created` (String) When the manufacturers was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the manufacturers, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the manufacturer.
- `devicetype_count` (Number) The number of devicetype objects that refer to the manufacturers.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the manufacturer.
- `inventoryitem_count` (Number) The number of inventoryitem objects that refer to the manufacturers.
- `last_updated` (String) When the manufacturers was last changed.
- `moduletype_count` (Number) The number of moduletype objects that refer to the manufacturers.
- `name` (String) The name of the manufacturer.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the manufacturers.
- `platform_count` (Number) The number of platform objects that refer to the manufacturers.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the manufacturer.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
